about.title: WHO AM I?
about.p1: My name is Kacper, I'm 25 years old and I'm consistently growing as an AI and fullstack developer. I focus on building practical projects that I publish on GitHub, gaining real experience working with applications, data and AI-based systems.
about.p2: I'm interested in building modern solutions using language models, RAG and various API integrations. I also develop my knowledge through online courses, gain frontend experience by building websites and believe in continuous growth through action. In the future I want to specialize in AI and build my career as an AI Engineer.
